simple.meaning: צָבָה (tsâbâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to amass , i.e. grow turgid ; specifically, to array an army against.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Numbers, beginning at Numbers 5:22. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָבָה (H6638).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
